result.title: SpatialVec: A Unified Representation Learning Framework for Geospatial Objects with Boundary-Aware Sampling
result.comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data as a full research paper
result.summary: Spatial representation learning is essential for Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) applications, enabling machine learning models to capture the geometry, location, and spatial relationships of geographic entities such as points, polylines, and polygons. Existing spatial encoding methods often struggle to preserve fine-grained topological information, particularly for interactions involving complex geometries such as polylines and polygons. These approaches inadequately capture boundary structure and local spatial context, causing topology-sensitive relationships near geometry boundaries to be underrepresented in the learned embedding space. Consequently, accurately modeling complex spatial interactions remains a significant challenge for downstream spatial reasoning tasks. To fill the gap, we introduce SpatialVec, a boundary-aware spatial representation learning framework that adaptively samples geometry boundaries and their surrounding regions, capturing fine-grained geometric structures critical for topology-aware spatial reasoning. A transformer-based encoder-decoder trained through geometry reconstruction produces compact, geometry-aware, and unified representations for points, polylines, and polygons. Empirical evaluation on two real-world datasets shows that SpatialVec substantially improves the preservation of challenging topological relationships involving polygonal interactions and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines significantly on downstream prediction and classification tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SpatialVec，用边界自适应采样与基于几何重建的 transformer 编码器-解码器，为点、折线、多边形学习统一的几何感知空间表示，并在两个真实数据集的下游任务上验证其对拓扑关系的保留效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作并非 VLM 推理研究，但「边界感知采样 + 几何重建监督」以及显式评估嵌入空间中的边界与拓扑关系保留，可能为核查 latent 状态是否保留细粒度几何与实体关系细节、以及如何设计此类细节保真度评价提供线索。
